trends.name: Iran War Oil Supply Shock
trends.summary: Brent crude surged above $100/bbl as Iran war escalation persists and de-escalation hopes fade. Iran imposing $2M transit fees through Strait of Hormuz; analysts project $120/bbl upside as 16MMB/d supply at risk. U.S. moving 82nd Airborne deployment suggesting military escalation, while Saudi/UAE backing U.S.-Israeli campaign.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Power Grid Investment
trends.summary: Breaking: Meta names Andy Bosworth to lead AI-for-Work initiative; Shopify integrating ChatGPT agentic storefronts. Broader theme: $2T grid rebuild needed over 5-10 years to support AI power demands. Mobileye positioned as robotaxi play; CoreWeave/Nebius infrastructure bets emerging.

trends.name: Stablecoin Regulation & Crypto Volatility
trends.summary: Circle hits worst day on record after proposed law threatens stablecoin yield products. Regulatory uncertainty over digital asset returns creating sharp selloff. Broader backdrop: blockchain digitalization advancing (Securitize NYSE first digital transfer agent) but policy risk rising.

trends.name: Fed Rate Hike Unlikely Despite Oil Shock
trends.summary: Despite 30% market pricing of summer rate hike, Fed unlikely to tighten as labor market softens from AI displacement and geopolitical uncertainty constrains action. 10yr yield dipping below 4.4%, signaling deflationary expectations despite oil inflation. Rate cut expectations remain viable.

trends.name: Commercial Aviation Premium Seat Expansion
trends.summary: United Airlines ditching economy seats to expand premium cabin space—structural shift in airline economics toward higher-margin business travel. Delta suspending Congressional perks amid DHS shutdown, signaling operational pressure. Airlines benefiting from higher fares amid geopolitical disruptions.

trends.name: Precious Metals Rally on War Risk
trends.summary: Silver explosive upside potential amid Iran conflict; gold traditionally benefiting from geopolitical uncertainty. War risk making 'boring' retirement strategies (Treasury/precious metals focus) increasingly attractive after decades of underperformance. Inflation hedges rotating in favor.

trends.name: Tech Earnings Mixed Amid Macro Headwinds
trends.summary: Micron sinks fourth straight day despite dominant earnings—growth uncertainty overriding fundamentals. Xiaomi, Drägerwerk, Celestica earnings mixed. Market concerned about 2026 being weak year for U.S. stocks historically. Datadog positioned as SaaS exception; AI chip bottleneck shifting per Celestica.

trends.name: Energy Sector Supply Shock Tailwinds
trends.summary: Iran war supply disruptions benefiting energy stocks and reopening oil rally debate. American Electric Power positioned for electrification boom. Sandfire Resources embedding sustainability/governance in operations. Energy transition thesis competing with near-term supply shock benefits.

trends.name: AI Arms Race & Pentagon Anthropic Ban
trends.summary: Pentagon ban on Anthropic facing legal injunction—AI geopolitical competition intensifying. OpenAI revamping ChatGPT shopping, Shopify integrating agentic commerce. Elizabeth Warren warning on teen banking app (MrBeast) pushing risky investments. Regulatory scrutiny on AI deployment accelerating.

trends.name: Yen Carry Trade Unwind Risk Resurging
trends.summary: Another yen carry trade unwind identified as growing risk amid rising geopolitical uncertainty and potential Fed policy divergence. Market leverage exposure high; Iran war volatility could trigger forced deleveraging across leveraged positions globally.

trends.name: Cybersecurity Stock Outperformance
trends.summary: Market repeatedly underestimating cybersecurity sector amid geopolitical tensions. Analysts buying more as valuations remain compressed despite rising demand from Iran war escalation and critical infrastructure threats. Defensive positioning gaining favor.

trends.name: Geopolitical Recession vs. Economic Resilience
trends.summary: Jamie Dimon paradoxically bullish on long-term Middle East peace prospects; Wells Fargo sees U.S. economy weathering oil shock with contained inflation. France GDP flat (0.2% Q1-Q2), inflation accelerating to 2.2% by June. Debate: Is this 1970s-style stagflation or manageable shock?
